opportunities.title: Interplay 2027
opportunities.summary: A 15–45 minute live online performance at the intersection of performance and technology.

support.detail: Artist fee per selected artist or group.

eligibility.text: International, all disciplines and career stages. Priority for projects led by women, femmes and gender-diverse artists.

opportunities.requirements: Bio, proposal, duration, three descriptive words, up to five minutes of support footage, and 3–5 promotional images.
opportunities.terms: Selected artists provide a technical breakdown, a five-minute highlight edit and development-process documentation. Live performance must be central to the work.

opportunities.title: Djerassi Artist Residencies
opportunities.summary: One month of studio time in the Santa Cruz Mountains for composers, media artists and other disciplines.

support.detail: Residency provided at no cost. Cash stipend not confirmed; travel is self-funded.

eligibility.text: National and international artists. Apply in one discipline; attendance for the full residency is required.

opportunities.requirements: Recent work samples, with formats and limits depending on discipline. Review the full application before preparing materials.
opportunities.terms: No shortened or partial residencies. Collaborators and couples must apply individually. Full form requirements, including references, have not been verified.

opportunities.title: smallforms — Solo Sets
opportunities.summary: Solo experimental music and sound performances, with an optional recording session for a digital release.

support.detail: Confirmed artist fee. Travel and accommodation support not stated.

eligibility.text: Musicians, sound artists and performers. One artist per proposal; no geographic restriction stated.

opportunities.requirements: Audio/video links, a proposal of at most 600 characters, and a short CV. State whether you also want a recording session. Apply by email via the official call.
opportunities.terms: In-person solo performance. Recording-session releases use the smallforms label; confirm release terms if selected.

opportunities.title: Eyebeam — AGENCY
opportunities.summary: A virtual residency for early-stage work exploring agency through art and technology.
opportunities.location: Online · US outside New York City

support.detail: Stipend, mentorship, technical consultation and weekly residency programming.

eligibility.text: Individuals based in the US outside NYC, remaining US-based throughout. No full-time degree enrollment or overlapping residency commitments.

opportunities.requirements: Written answers, CV, work samples and a personal 1–2 minute introduction video, via Submittable.
opportunities.terms: Weekly cohort participation and independent project work. The live application specifies 3–4 cohort hours weekly plus independent work; confirm the schedule before accepting.

opportunities.title: Music for Your Inbox
opportunities.summary: Unpremiered experimental sound and music films for an online series and library screenings.

deadline.note: 23:59 PST as published; daylight-saving ambiguity — submit early

support.detail: Honorarium. Limited production support is available for co-produced films.

eligibility.text: Artists and artist teams; no geographic restriction stated. Music or sound must be central. Films must be 10–20 minutes and not previously premiered.

opportunities.requirements: A film proposal and samples demonstrating the proposed work. Finished or nearly finished projects are best suited to the available support.
opportunities.terms: One year of exclusive presentation rights. Ordinary concert documentation is excluded. In-person attendance is not required. The organizer discourages creating a new project solely for this call.

opportunities.title: Lendhauer — Urban Ecologies
opportunities.summary: Public artworks exploring coexistence, control and interdependence at Klagenfurt’s Lendhafen.

support.detail: Up to €2,500 gross artist fee, €4,000 gross production and €1,000 travel, per selected project.

eligibility.text: Individuals and collectives in Austria and abroad, including artists, designers, performers and interdisciplinary practitioners.

opportunities.requirements: One PDF, at most 15 MB: project proposal up to three pages, production estimate, bio/CV and portfolio up to ten pages. Apply by email via the official call.
opportunities.terms: The proposal must engage with the actual harbor and its social, ecological and material conditions. Timing is agreed with selected artists. Fee is per project, not per collaborator.

opportunities.title: SPOT FLUX — Sound Art
opportunities.summary: Existing sound works, music films and performances for SPOT Festival’s experimental program.

deadline.note: 14:00 as published; time zone not explicitly stated

support.detail: Danish Musicians’ Union rate per performer, with approved technical and material costs. Exact fee not stated.

eligibility.text: The work and/or artists must have a connection to Denmark. Existing works only; the artist must attend the presentation.

opportunities.requirements: Application form, work documentation and an estimated budget including rights costs. The work must be practical to set up and take down quickly.
opportunities.terms: Travel, accommodation and preparation expenses are not covered. The Café Stage is an open, busy space; quiet cannot be guaranteed.

opportunities.title: Amsterdam Light Festival
opportunities.summary: Light artworks for the canals of Amsterdam, with technical and financial support to realize selected concepts.

support.detail: Artist fee plus production and travel costs. General-call production ceiling is not specified in the FAQ.

eligibility.text: The general open call is worldwide, including people new to light art. The separate Amarte call is restricted to Netherlands-based makers.

opportunities.requirements: Read the artist briefing, prepare a concept using the submission template (up to three pages), and submit through the linked portal.
opportunities.terms: Work must withstand two months outdoors and avoid nuisance to residents, including sound, smoke and lasers. Full briefing and contract terms need review.

opportunities.title: OPENFEED
opportunities.summary: A virtual residency spanning interactive installations, software art, sound, electronics and participatory work.
opportunities.location: Online · FEED Media Art Center, US

deadline.note: Rolling review within the October 1–February 28 application window

support.detail: Hardware, computing, software and mentorship. Cash support and exact program dates are not confirmed.

fee.text: Free to apply · form checked Oct 5

eligibility.text: International artists working across digital, electronic and experimental media. Individual and participatory practices welcome.

opportunities.requirements: Artist and project information with work samples through the official application form.
opportunities.terms: Development may combine an online edition with an on-site presentation. Confirm resources, dates and any attendance requirements before accepting.

opportunities.title: Sequoia Open Source Fellowship
opportunities.summary: Living-expense support for developers sustaining important open-source projects.

support.detail: Six to twelve months of support, equity-free. Amount is individualized rather than a published fixed award.

fee.text: Free to apply · form checked Oct 5

eligibility.text: Open-source developers; no geographic restriction stated in the reviewed application. A small cohort is selected each year.

opportunities.requirements: Eight short application fields covering the project, contribution history, impact and need for support.
opportunities.terms: No equity or required travel. Confirm the support amount and work expectations with the organizer.

opportunities.title: Michigan Central Art × Newlab — Creative Residency 2027
opportunities.summary: A 12-week research residency in Detroit at the intersection of art, technology, health and society, in an Art & Tech track (Knight Foundation) or an Art & Health track (Henry Ford Health).
opportunities.dates: Session One February 8 – April 30, 2027; Session Two May 17 – August 6, 2027

deadline.note: Published as 11:59 p.m. EST, though Detroit is on EDT that day — submit early

support.detail: Plus Newlab fabrication shops, project-aligned research, mentors and a public conversation series.

eligibility.text: Single applicants over 25, able to receive taxable US income via SSN, ITIN or EIN. No groups.

opportunities.requirements: Submittable application; the organizers suggest about five hours in total, including selected work samples.
opportunities.terms: Fellows are announced in January 2027 and are expected in Detroit for their 12-week session.

opportunities.title: City of Los Angeles DCA — Neighborhood Engagement Artist Residency (NEAR) 2027–28
opportunities.summary: A grant for a participatory, workshop-based artist residency at a non-arts venue in one City of Los Angeles council district — libraries, community and youth centres and the like.

support.detail: May be reduced to $6,000 for five workshops plus one event if the City's budget is cut.

eligibility.text: Individual artists (or teams under one lead) residing in Los Angeles County with a largely self-directed community practice.

opportunities.requirements: A business plan for at least 200 hours: eleven workshops of about 20 participants and a culminating public event of 40+, plus host-venue details and attachments, via SurveyMonkey Apply.
opportunities.terms: Notification May–June 2027. The companion CO-UP track is for social-justice nonprofits naming a teaching artist.

opportunities.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
opportunities.summary: An eight-month fellowship for artists, educators and engineers building open-source tools and resources for the arts. Every project must build on p5.js, the p5.js Editor or Processing.
opportunities.location: United States (hybrid in New York or Los Angeles, or remote)

deadline.note: Nominations close 11:59 PM PST; invited nominees submit proposals by November 23

support.detail: Plus open-source mentorship, a cohort, professional development and public programs.

eligibility.text: US-based nominees only; self-nomination is welcome. Hybrid fellows must be in New York or Los Angeles.

opportunities.requirements: A nomination first; selected nominees are invited on November 2 to submit a full proposal, with an info session on November 7.
opportunities.terms: Video interviews the week of December 7; fellows notified the week of December 14; final presentations October 2, 2027.

opportunities.title: NLnet — Open Internet Stack: Restack, first call
opportunities.summary: R&D grants for free and open-source software, open hardware, standards and other building blocks of an open internet stack, from the European Commission's NGI successor.
opportunities.dates: Projects begin after selection; the fund runs to 2030

deadline.note: 12:00 noon CET; NLnet now calls every two months, on the third of odd months

support.detail: Scalable later with proven potential; plus security, accessibility, licensing and packaging support.

eligibility.text: Open to anyone, but projects need a strong European dimension — normally 60% of funds to people in Horizon Europe-eligible countries; others only for exceptional quality or unique expertise.

opportunities.requirements: A proposal through nlnet.nl/propose, selecting the Restack call. All outcomes must be published under recognised open licences.

opportunities.title: Social Web Foundation — Fediverse Multimedia Grants
opportunities.summary: Grants for a developer team and a creator or publisher who together start a new audio, video or image publication on the Fediverse, improving ActivityPub software for creators along the way.

support.detail: Funded by the Interledger Foundation; a grant, no equity.

eligibility.text: Developer-and-creator teams only. The foundation will try to match a developer or publisher who applies without a partner.

opportunities.requirements: An application on the foundation's grants portal covering the software, the new publication, collaboration, schedule, budget and impact.
opportunities.terms: The publication must be new and on the Fediverse.

opportunities.title: City of Los Angeles DCA — COLA Independent Master Artist Projects 2027–29
opportunities.summary: A grant for an accomplished Los Angeles mid-career artist to make a new solo work, with a City catalog and a likely premiere. A new Graphic Design category covers books, typefaces and text–image work.

deadline.note: 11:59 pm online; a hard copy must be postmarked by November 18

support.detail: Subject to the City budget; non-selected applicants may be named DCA Cultural Trailblazers with a stipend.

eligibility.text: Los Angeles County residents who live in the City or have presented there for 3+ years, with a 15-year exhibition, publication or performance record. Collaborative or audience-interactive projects are ineligible.

opportunities.requirements: Online application via SurveyMonkey Apply after reading the guidelines, plus a mailed hard copy of the proposal.
opportunities.terms: Grantees contribute catalog materials and use the funds for a new solo work. Results June–July 2027.

opportunities.title: Akademie der Künste — Mensch Maschine VISIT Residency 2027 (“Energy Ghosts”)
opportunities.summary: Four funded fellowships for new projects at the intersection of art, energy and ecology, critically engaging the “human machine” and pluriversal approaches to digital technology.
opportunities.location: E-WERK Luckenwalde or Akademie der Künste, Berlin
opportunities.dates: Residency mid-August – mid-November 2027; retreat in Warsaw in September; symposium in autumn 2027

deadline.note: 11:59 pm as published; time zone not stated

support.detail: For artist fees and production; studio and accommodation provided.

eligibility.text: Artists from anywhere, across visual art, performance, film, installation, sound, writing and new media.

opportunities.requirements: An application through the programme's portal.
opportunities.terms: Fellows live and work on site at least 75% of the three-month residency. Jury in January 2027.
